title: fix(vscode-ide-companion): preserve split stream message ordering

target.summary: Reusing the initial stream timestamp (currentStreamTimestampRef.current) for subsequent assistant segments gives them a timestamp earlier than intermediate tool calls. Consequently, timeline sorting places tool calls at the end of the turn instead of interleaving them between assistant segments.
notes: reusing initial stream timestamp for split assistant segments sorts them before intermediate tool calls
reusing initial stream timestamp for thinking segments (copy of the same pattern)
records the initial turn timestamp that is later reused for split segments
